criterion.question: can proposal-only discovery discard a candidate that exact certification would have selected?
criterion.primary: the certified winner is promoted in 100% of cells
criterion.frontier: recall of the certified top-5 is at least 90% across all cells
criterion.not_the_criterion: agreement between discovery scores and certified scores. D18 established they diverge structurally and the architecture assumes they always will.

certification_contract.instrument: gen2_frequency.solve_exact over a rotating block neighbourhood
certification_contract.rotation: offset advances by n_keys // 2 each round
certification_contract.anchor: the plan being certified, re-anchored after every improvement
certification_contract.guarantee: no block of 8 route-periods moved within 3 ladder rungs of the certified plan improves the objective

promotion_rule.name: permissive_frontier
promotion_rule.statement: Promote every FEASIBLE proposal whose discovery objective is within WINDOW_REL of the best discovery objective; if that yields fewer than FLOOR_N, promote the FLOOR_N best instead; never promote more than CAP_N, and record cap_binding when the cap truncates the set.
promotion_rule.order: ascending discovery objective, then state_key for determinism
promotion_rule.asymmetry: false positives cost only compute because certification removes them; false negatives are unrecoverable
promotion_rule.may_decide: frontier membership only; never a conclusion

proposal_rule.name: multi_start_structural
proposal_rule.supersedes: revision 1: a single steepest-descent trajectory from one seed, which covered 79% of an enumerable space and missed the certified winner in 2 of 5 C9 cells
proposal_rule.starts: the preregistered structural family (max, min, per-cardinality spread and half-stride offset, incumbent where applicable, greedy-add, greedy-drop, OFF-density variants), followed by 24 diversified starts from fixed schedule 20260906
proposal_rule.proposal_set: the union of EVERY unique candidate visited on every trajectory, not only the terminal optima
proposal_rule.budget: a shared pool of 2000 unique scored evaluations per cell; a start that converges early releases the remainder; starts continue until the pool is exhausted or the family is finished
proposal_rule.stopping_rule: never stop globally because one start reached a local optimum
proposal_rule.memoization: scores are memoized across starts; duplicate visits are counted and reported but charged nothing

rule.name: permissive_frontier
rule.statement: Promote every FEASIBLE proposal whose discovery objective is within WINDOW_REL of the best discovery objective; if that yields fewer than FLOOR_N, promote the FLOOR_N best instead; never promote more than CAP_N, and record cap_binding when the cap truncates the set.
rule.order: ascending discovery objective, then state_key for determinism
rule.asymmetry: false positives cost only compute because certification removes them; false negatives are unrecoverable
rule.may_decide: frontier membership only; never a conclusion
